output.summary: An evergreen shrub or small tree native to Assam, Cambodia, China, the Himalayas, Hainan, Japan, Myanmar, Taiwan, Nepal, Thailand and Vietnam, sweet olive bears strongly fragrant white, yellow or orange-yellow flowers in late summer and autumn. In Chinese cuisine, the flowers may be infused with tea and are also used in jams, cakes, dumplings, soups, liquor and traditional desserts.
